finding.statement: Finished native requests are admitted to an asynchronous queue and four metadata workers; action finalization clones NetworkEntries without ensuring work already accepted has published or failed. A native load completion does not join these local workers. This yields a race between accepted metadata acquisition and immutable action/archive snapshots.
finding.causality_limit: The current failure logs33 retained entries but fails before logging its independent server request map or pending metadata state. The missing barrier is source-proven; its precise contribution to that33 count is inferred rather than proved by a recorded pending-task count. Previous local run observed81/81 and passed physical JSONL/Parquet pagination.

not_required: No new public opt-in, route, DSL/API/protobuf/schema or arbitrary callback. Use existing typed documentMetricsEnabled opt-in; basic browser path stays asynchronous.

design.scope_gate: Wait only for documentMetricsEnabled detailed capture. Preserve ordinary browser timing/no receipt allocation on the baseline path where practical.
design.state: One private worker-state pointer per exact native context/generation, with lifecycle-stop signal and pending set of individual accepted-task receipts. Receipts carry owner state and a private done channel. Bound pending size by cap(existing queue)+4 existing workers, ordinarily256+4, with no unbounded cumulative sequence/finished-hole history.
design.admission: Under b.mu verify exact current state/generation/not closing; register the receipt and attempt the existing nonblocking queue send in the same critical section. On stop or full queue roll back the not-accepted receipt and retain existing drop/incomplete accounting. Do not enlarge queue/ring/body/metadata limits or spawn per-request workers.
design.completion: Execute each recordNetworkTask in a small per-task wrapper with a deferred receipt completion, so defers do not accumulate in the worker loop. Close the exact task receipt and remove only from its owner pending set after append/refusal. Preserve original panic propagation; defer may flag that owner incomplete before completion, without swallowing panic. Generation refusal still completes the old obligation without touching new-generation state.
design.barrier: Immediately before the detailed action network snapshot, capture the current finite pending receipt set and exact owner/generation under b.mu. Release mutex and wait only for these receipts; future accepted tasks never extend the set. Individual receipts avoid falsely treating out-of-order completions as a contiguous done prefix.
design.budget: Per parent decision one finite maximum5-second metadata-settling budget for the entire captured set, shortened by parent cancellation/deadline; not5seconds per receipt. Do not change native80fixture30s deadline or >50 threshold. Keep settling outside already-measured action duration, matching current metadata acquisition placement.
design.snapshot: After waiting, reacquire b.mu and verify exact worker-state pointer/generation/not closing. Clone bounded retained entries under that same lock and return the detached snapshot to finalization. Do not call a later generic buffer read that could observe a replacement context. Preserve deep BrowserEvidence clone/native zero and false/source identity fields.
design.retirement: On close/reset retire only the owned state and close its stop signal once, waking waiters before potentially blocked native physical join. Existing physical worker/HAR ownership joins remain authoritative. Never fabricate receipt success for dropped/abandoned work; stop/cancel reports incompleteness. Late old completions can retire their own receipts but cannot remove current pending tasks or append current evidence.
design.failure_disposition: Timeout/cancel/stale state must retain explicit incomplete acquisition status and set existing document-evidence Incomplete only when exact generation still matches. Use bounded controlled reasons for metadata timeout/cancellation/lifecycle change, without raw URLs/errors. Do not synthesize missing entries or count uncompleted metadata as successful capture; do not label retained observations a full request census. Preserve existing action-error rules; evidence incompleteness alone must not invent target failure.
design.privacy: No additional target traffic, probes, sleeps-for-network-idle, new raw response capture or weakened disclosure policy; only wait on locally accepted metadata receipts.
